chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh — may Allah be pleased with him — from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad Khālid, from al-Haytham ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Nahdī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlwān, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf, from al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah.

key_terms.أَحْمَدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ خَالِدٍ: A named transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْأَصْبَغِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ: A narrator from whom reports in this section are transmitted
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct narration by the compiler
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father; a link within the chain of transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a transmission-note establishing the sanad/isnad for reports in the book that come through al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah. Its significance lies in documenting how the author received and transmitted this material through a named chain of narrators.
